description: This file defines the GLAccountRepositoryWrapper class, which provides methods to retrieve GLAccount entities from the repository with not-found detection, wrapping the underlying repository's methods.

classes.name: GLAccountRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps the GLAccountRepository to provide not-found detection when fetching GLAccount entities.

methods.name: GLAccountRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GLAccountRepository dependency.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Fetches a GLAccount by ID, throws GLAccountNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findOneByGlCodeWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Fetches a GLAccount by GL code, throws GLAccountNotFoundException if not found.
